name: mdx-concierge-twin-symmetry-proof

proofs.assertion: Concierge and Twin cite the same receipt ids when answering from the same evidence packet.
Neither surface may answer from UI-only state, app-local memory, or route-local facts.
Twin may advise from evidence now; loops, workers, credentials, spend, deployment, provider, memory, or write hooks require governed action rails.

rules: symmetry compares cited evidence, not prose wording
Twin can add companion framing only after citing the same evidence packet
Concierge remains the question surface and Twin remains the companion surface
